source_evidence: D327 player exact 'As far as we need to' in reply to Mara's question how far V is willing to let the prospective associates believe he is interested. V permits maintaining the commercial pretext as needed, not actual illegal commerce, payment, signed undertaking, threats, unrelated V speech, spell use or other expenditure. Mara agrees to maintain the genuine business angle but leave commitments to V. Under V's prior accepted plan to keep the 15:00 appointment, carry routine intervening time and return to Veldrake townhouse; no intervening purchase, lunch charge, ration/feed use, new rest or recovery credited (lunch not resolved). D327~15:00 V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar together arrive at townhouse; routine reception at the previously offered appointment, attendant shows group to a private household business room. Jorveth Sallow, previously publicly identified purchasing agent, is actually present and willing to receive prospective client as directed by Halvessa. First-play visual details: silver-gray hair, well-cut dark coat, sober manner, desk with neatly arranged ledgers. Reference illustration https://www.dndreinkarnated.com/content/images/2023/05/Sebastian-Greycastle---Portrait.png is visual inspiration only, not identity/canon imported from another setting. His principal informed him of V's river interests and desire to meet Tavosk; he does not automatically know Watch investigation, covert office search, evidence custody or exact V knowledge. He opens: 'Her ladyship tells me you have interests upriver, and that you wish to speak with Master Tavosk. Before I arrange anything, tell me what you are looking for. Is it the cost of moving goods, or the difficulties of getting them through the berths?' No actual Tavosk appearance, introduction arranged, private payment disclosure, corroborating statement, written proposal, roll, pledge or deal yet. V controls reply; Mara willing to provide meaningful Help, Cirren listening, Fenar attentive. No active spell or new resource changes.
